products.title: Enterprise Web3 Business Website & Client Portal
products.description: Turnkey enterprise business portal engineered with React 19, Node.js, and Tailwind CSS. Features Web3 wallet connectivity, client portal dashboard, digital invoice generation, and full commercial license.
deliverables: Complete production-ready source code with full commercial transfer
Role-based customer and administrator portal with responsive layouts
Integrated multi-currency invoice generation and webhook endpoints
30-day technical warranty, deployment assistance & handover docs

products.title: Custom Cloud SaaS & High-Concurrency Dashboard
products.description: Production-ready multi-tenant cloud software with PostgreSQL/Cloud SQL schema, secure RESTful API gateways, real-time analytics, and role-based access control.
deliverables: Scalable microservices/Express backend with database migrations
Real-time operational metrics & revenue analytics dashboard
Role-based permission matrix (SuperAdmin, Staff, Client, Auditor)
Automated CI/CD deployment scripts and architectural blueprint

products.title: Autonomous AI Front-Desk Receptionist & WhatsApp Handoff
products.description: 24/7 autonomous front-desk conversational AI powered by server-side Google Gemini models. Answers company service inquiries, qualifies prospects, and routes warm leads directly to WhatsApp.
deliverables: Server-side Gemini AI integration with zero client key exposure
Custom business knowledge base ingestion (pricing, services, FAQs)
Automated lead capture modal with CRM dispatch
1-click WhatsApp click-to-chat escalation with lead summary context

products.title: Autonomous AI Operations & Business Workflow Suite
products.description: End-to-end automation engine that parses inbound inquiries, generates formal quotes, tracks delivery milestones, and automates multi-channel notifications.
deliverables: Automated invoice & contract generation pipeline
Document OCR & extraction engine for incoming invoices
Automated SMS, Email & WhatsApp milestone notification triggers
Custom webhook connectors for Zapier, Make, and internal ERPs

products.title: Web3 Growth Engine & Performance Digital Marketing Suite
products.description: Omnichannel customer acquisition campaign engineered for Web3 products, local businesses, and digital services. Includes high-converting ad copy, Pioneer community campaigns, and conversion analytics.
deliverables: 3 high-converting landing page variants with A/B testing setup
Targeted social media ad copy & creative pack (Meta, Google, X)
Pi Network pioneer community engagement strategy playbook
Conversion tracking pixel integration & weekly ROI performance audit

products.title: Corporate CAC Incorporation & Verified Business Registration
products.description: Full legal business entity registration in Nigeria (Corporate Affairs Commission RC/BN), Federal Tax Identification Number (TIN), corporate board resolution templates, and instant GOYE Level 4 Verified ID Badge.
deliverables: Official CAC Certificate of Incorporation & Status Report document
Federal Inland Revenue Service Tax Identification Number (TIN)
Standardized corporate resolution templates & MEMART documentation
GOYE Level 4 Identity Confirmed verified cryptographic business profile

products.title: gasv.store Curated Digital Assets & Turnkey Codebases
products.description: Commercial developer asset bundle from gasv.store featuring production TypeScript boilerplates, smart contract integration scripts, e-commerce checkout components, and mobile web view wrappers.
deliverables: 5 modular production GitHub repositories with full commercial rights
Pi SDK v2 boilerplate with server-side approval/completion endpoints
Plug-and-play Tailwind CSS v4 design token pack & component library
Comprehensive developer setup guide & 1-click Vercel/Docker deploy configs

products.title: Enterprise Figma UI/UX Design System & Mobile App Templates
products.description: Enterprise Figma UI/UX design library with 120+ responsive Web3 & SaaS components, Dark Obsidian and Gold luxury themes, typography tokens, and complete mobile screen flows.
deliverables: Comprehensive Figma community-grade .FIG master file with variables
120+ pre-built components (buttons, modals, tables, QR cards, charts)
Complete desktop, tablet, and mobile responsive layout mockups
WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliant color palettes and typography rules

products.title: Cryptographic Legal Contracts & Smart Invoicing Engine
products.description: Cryptographically verified digital contracts and automated multi-currency billing suite. Features SHA-256 digital signature hashes, mutual sign-off timestamps, and verifiable QR validation endpoints.
deliverables: Standardized commercial contract templates for services, supply, and tech
Multi-currency invoice generation engine supporting NGN, USD, EUR, and Pi
Cryptographic SHA-256 signature verification endpoints & QR badges
Automatic audit trail logging and PDF export infrastructure

products.title: Official Pi Network Platform API & SDK Integration Suite
products.description: Enterprise integration of official Pi Network Platform API v2 and Pi SDK v2. Includes server-to-server payment approval, payment completion, user authentication, and Pi Browser domain validation.
deliverables: Complete server-to-server approval (/api/pi/approve) & completion (/api/pi/complete) endpoints
Official Pi OAuth 2.0 Sign-in integration with CSRF state protection
Domain validation file deployment (/validation-key.txt)
Strict anti-mock architecture compliant with Pi Developer Portal guidelines

products.title: Sirwise Academy: Web3 & AI Business Architecture Masterclass
products.description: Comprehensive executive video masterclass and hands-on developer training covering decentralized commerce models, Pi Network developer architecture, server-side AI engineering, and trade assurance.
deliverables: 48 modular high-definition video lessons and downloadable code labs
10 production starter repositories with automated CI/CD configurations
Weekly live Q&A sessions with certified Web3 & AI enterprise architects
Verifiable digital graduation certificate with permanent QR verification reference

products.title: Enterprise Digital Transformation & Web3 Strategic Advisory
products.description: Direct advisory engagement for mid-market and enterprise leadership navigating digital transformation, multi-rail payment adoption (fiat + Pi), corporate compliance, and automated AI operations.
deliverables: Four 90-minute executive strategy and technical scoping sessions
Comprehensive infrastructure and security architecture audit report
Tailored Web3 & AI adoption roadmap with 30-60-90 day milestone milestones
Regulatory compliance assessment & vendor selection recommendations

products.title: Multi-Tenant CRM & Inbound Lead Dispatch Cloud Platform
products.description: Enterprise customer relationship management software designed for digital sales teams. Automates lead intake from website forms and AI receptionists, assigns sales reps, and tracks deal closing.
deliverables: Cloud-hosted multi-tenant CRM portal with customized sales pipelines
Automated lead assignment engine based on sales agent capacity and region
Automated WhatsApp and email drip follow-up sequences
Customer lifetime value, conversion rate, and revenue reporting dashboards

products.title: Corporate Web3 Brand Identity & Motion Design Suite
products.description: High-impact brand identity suite tailored for fintechs, Web3 projects, and modern enterprises. Includes 3D metallic logo emblems, motion logo reveal loops, investor pitch decks, and brand style guides.
deliverables: High-resolution vector brand mark package in SVG, PDF, and transparent PNG
3D metallic emblem animation loop (4K MP4 & transparent WebM)
Comprehensive 28-page brand identity guideline manual (typography, color codes)
Executive pitch deck template in Figma and PowerPoint formats

products.title: TradeShield Cross-Border Trade Assurance & Milestone Escrow
products.description: Structured trade protection protocol for cross-border and B2B commerce. Enforces a 7-stage milestone inspection pipeline, tamper-evident cargo documentation, and non-custodial milestone release.
deliverables: 7-stage milestone verification agreement and milestone release contract
On-the-ground cargo inspection documentation and digital photographic logs
Third-party neutral dispute mitigation and record reconciliation desk
Verifiable trade assurance certificate and public QR status ledger
